ai-factory.notes: Validated against upstream 2.17.0 on the 2.x branch. The cumulative reviewed baseline preserves AI Factory 2.13.x plan-aware /aif-commit Commit Plan grouping and /aif-distillation for reusable Agent Skills, AI Factory 2.14 /aif-archive with paths.archive and archive-aware sequential plan behavior, config-aware project utilities /aif-architecture, /aif-docs, and /aif-qa as upstream-owned context outputs, and AI Factory 2.15 managed agent config preservation plus interactive newly available built-in skill update behavior. Headline 2.16-2.17 changes cover revision-bound research context, branch-scoped /aif-qa-check, regression-first /aif-fix evidence, and verbatim Original Request preservation. Direct follow-ups cover QA execution surfaces, collision-resistant branch identity, revision/worktree/source/case freshness, reusable non-sensitive QA memory, authorization and redaction, custom fix-plan preservation, plan/improve Original Request clarifications, Universal / Other MCP through .mcp.json, and project-evidence-backed Control Flow rules. Reviewed no-ops keep /aif-architecture structure upstream-owned, avoid duplicate generated-rules compiler logic, and do not copy community-extension documentation bodies.

openspec.notes: Validated sequentially from upstream OpenSpec 1.3.1 through 1.7.0, including reviewed prerelease 1.6.0-beta.1, while keeping the supported stable CLI range >=1.3.1 <2.0.0; prereleases remain unsupported for production capabilities. OpenSpec 1.7.0 adds native skip_specs metadata, apply/archive instructions, numeric-leading change IDs, nested spec folders, UTF-8 BOM handling, a default Store, new tool adapters, and a self-upgrading openspec update. AIFHub now honors native .openspec.yaml skip_specs during artifact validation and all-change sync, keeps recursive nested-spec discovery, supports archive instructions through the shared runner, and preserves the older numeric-ID status fallback for pre-1.7 CLIs. OpenSpec 1.6.0 unifies validate/view/archive resolution, makes archive validation failures exit non-zero, handles nested specs and task files, adds /opsx:update, Oh My Pi and Trae support, and fixes requirement parsing, archive drift, skill permissions, and fresh Store registration. OpenSpec 1.5.0 introduces Stores in very early beta, fixes config parsing and CRLF YAML frontmatter generation, and adds an additive root field to command JSON. AIFHub remains adapter-only and does not install or manage OpenSpec skills, /opsx:* commands, tool integrations, Stores, workspace beta state, or openspec update.
